name: 42718 · Campbellsvlle, KY
findings: ZIP 42718 (Campbellsvlle) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42718 (Campbellsvlle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
